Enterprise Business Transformation, Change Management, Data Science & Automation Leader
Enterprise transformation leader with ~20 years of experience driving large-scale business transformation and organizational change through Industry 4.0/5.0, data science, automation, and GenAI. Trusted delivering measurable CXO BOI/KPI outcomes across cost, quality, timeliness, compliance, and CSAT through operating model modernization, process mining, advanced analytics, and structured change management frameworks enabling adoption of digital platforms.
Enterprise-Wide multi-functional Transformation expert Data Science and Analytics Expert

Training & Capability Enablement
Digital Transformation & Behavioral Change Leadership
P E R S O N A L P R O F I L E
Transformation & Operations Excellence expert delivering secure, compliant, cost-efficient operating models through risk-based design, CX optimization, digital transformation, governance, and change management.
Process Excellence specialist leveraging Minitab, Celonis, Lean/Six Sigma, BOI, FMEA, Entitlement Studies, and VSM to eliminate NVA, strengthen governance, and scale reengineering.
Data Science & ML specialist using R, Python, SQL for regression, forecasting, classification, clustering, anomaly detection, sentiment analysis, and prescriptive insights. BI & Reporting Architect mastering Power BI, Power Query, Qlik Sense, Excel, delivering real-time KPIs, automated dashboards, and data-driven performance governance.
Analytics & Workforce Modelling expert in demand forecasting, CSAT, capacity, early-warning signals, metric standardization, and data-driven workforce planning.
Automation & GenAI enabler driving enterprise automation, AI integration, workflow digitization, unlocking FTE productivity and intelligent operations maturity. Program & Change Management professional delivering high-impact multi- geo transformation initiatives using structured change frameworks, stakeholder engagement, and adoption strategies to ensure successful transition to new operating models. CXO and Senior Leadership Engagements: Proven experience collaborating with CXOs and senior leaders to shape and execute enterprise-wide transformation agendas.

Led organizational change enablement for automation, analytics and digital platform initiatives across global delivery teams, ensuring adoption through stakeholder engagement, communication strategies and training enablement. Designed change communication strategies, stakeholder engagement plans and training enablement programs to ensure successful adoption of new operating models and digital platforms.

projects.name: Key Transformation Projects
projects.description:
Key Transformation Projects

Delivered end-to-end HR Procure-to-Pay (P2P) automation using Power Automate mini-bots and OCR for validations, invoicing and accrual workflows, achieving ~90% automation with improved turnaround time, SLA adherence, accuracy, and user experience.

Enabled enterprise HR transformation by migrating fragmented legacy systems (ATAS, Abacus) to Workday, delivering a unified global HR platform with standardized processes, enhanced compliance, and real-time workforce insights. Supported organizational change management including stakeholder engagement, communication enablement, training adoption, and workflow automation on the new platform.

Applied Prosci ADKAR change management principles across digital including automation, analytics platforms, and transformation operating model redesign, ensuring smooth adoption across global delivery teams.

satisfaction.
 Delivered AI-enabled contract and document management using Evisort, enabling clause extraction and metadata tagging to reduce cycle time, manual reviews, and compliance risk while improving governance.

Built advanced Power BI and Qlik Sense dashboards using SQL, R Studio, and Python, big data analytics including one named “Funnel Analyzer” for workforce forecasting, hiring timelines, sourcing effectiveness, and recruiter performance.

Identified and led multiple RPA initiatives across functions and processes to automate both workflows and manual processing.

Built and led multiple one-stop analytical dashboards leveraging SQL, R Studio, Big Data, and machine-learning models to deliver actionable business insights and decision support.

Conducted deep process studies and mining across functions/teams using Celonis, AIDT, entitlement, and time-and-motion analyses to identify rework, bottlenecks, overutilization, and non-value-added activities, eliminating them through workflow automation and RPA.
Deployment of operational excellence tools across functions and teams.
Operational Maturity, Quality & Governance

Led enterprise operational maturity assessments using Value Stream Mapping, Entitlement Studies, BOI Tree, Process Maturity Measurement, Benchmark Analytics Tool, SLAs/SLA+, and Standard Quality Framework, driving quality, efficiency, and contractual compliance outcomes.

Improved client experience and CSAT by enabling digital NPS and sentiment analytics dashboards, guiding insight interpretation, action planning, and validating improvements through recurring maturity checkpoints.

Strengthened enterprise risk and compliance maturity using Accenture Control Framework, FMEA, SOPs/LWIs, SIPOCs, early-warning indicators, and assurance reviews, ensuring audit-ready, controlled operations.

Translated contractual commitments into measurable delivery outcomes through BOI Tree mapping, maturity-linked KPIs, and governance reviews validating evidence and performance.
Automation, GenAI & Intelligent Operations

Assessed baseline productivity and designed automation and GenAI roadmaps leveraging RPA, LCNC, mini-bots, Generative AI–Human Assist, and Accenture platforms, validating benefits realization and productivity uplift.

Enabled advanced automation and intelligent operations maturity through process modernization and AI-driven interventions, achieving top-quartile productivity benchmarks.

Guided AI- and automation-led transformation roadmaps, validating readiness for autonomous and agentic operations using autonomy-focused maturity assessments.
Value Realization, Analytics & Diagnostics
Delivered maturity-led diagnostics using process mining, variance analysis, Value Stream Mapping, and analytics modelling to identify NVA, enable reengineering, and deliver measurable business outcomes across internal delivery teams.

Established enterprise BOI, SLA, and KPI governance frameworks enabling automation pipelines, benefits-realization validation, and outcome-based value tracking.

Built enterprise KPI architectures and 3×3 leading–lagging frameworks using Regression analytics.

Built and also enabled one stop shop digital dashboards to improve business intelligence using Power BI, Qlik Sense ,big-data analytics and machine learning to enable forecasting, performance monitoring, and improvement advisory.
CXO Advisory, Governance & Assurance

Advised senior leadership on end-to-end enterprise transformation roadmaps, validating CXO-level business outcomes through maturity-driven governance.
Owned monthly operational maturity assessments across multiple OMIDs, ensuring Operational Excellence adherence, stage progression, leadership reporting, digital governance, and performance appraisal alignment.

Acted as cross-functional Business Transformation Auditor, validating maturity scores, evidence quality, control effectiveness, and outcome realization across internal portfolios.

Established enterprise including maturity scorecards, ROI models, automation feasibility playbooks, benefit-validation mechanisms, and finance-approved business cases.
transformation governance

Built organization-wide capability by delivering Yellow Belt and Green Belt programs and change enablement workshops, embedding a continuous improvement, automation-first and transformation-ready culture.
Operational Excellence Platforms & Tool Deployments

Led Accenture Control Framework deployment by designing process-specific controls, executing phased rollouts, embedding failure-mode analysis, and delivering measurable compliance, risk mitigation, and governance benefits.
Drove process maturity uplift by deploying Process Maturity Measurement and Benchmarking Analytics Tool, benchmarking against global standards and delivering targeted efficiency improvements.

Partnered with compliance teams to deploy Standard Quality Framework, strengthening end-to-end audit readiness and alignment with evolving quality requirements.
Deployed Global Productivity Hub to 2,000+ users, managing UAT-to-go-live and delivering analytics on efficiency, productivity utilization, and capacity utilization to identify automation opportunities.
Project Manager / Team Lead Accenture Services Pvt. Ltd. | Oct 2010 – Feb 2015 | Client: AT&T Corp.
Managed telecom lifecycle projects, navigating phases involving legal, finance, carrier relations, onboarding, billing system updates and compliance checkpoints.

Prepared business cases, financial justifications & documentation to secure approvals from legal, finance & carrier-relations divisions.

Closed projects in line with SLA timelines while monitoring risks, dependencies, documentation, and cross-functional coordination.

Creating advanced excel and analytical models for Vendor penalty and multiple reports and dashboards for leadership reporting.

Participated in OE and quality initiatives creating process artefacts such as SIPOCs, FMEAs, DLPMs, HLPMs, 3x3 metrics & risk logs to strengthen operational excellence.

Led quality initiatives and contributed to innovative internal platforms such as “Aura” for engagement and collaboration.

Developed analytical Excel-based models to manage inventory levels, reduce DC accumulation & smoothen replenishment cycles, minimizing bullwhip effects and improving throughput.

Collaborated with purchasing teams and category managers to plan promotional strategies to maximize sales and liquidity.
Diagnosed merchandise availability issues and partnered with supply chain teams to resolve store-level stockouts.

Contributed to process excellence through creation of quality frameworks (FMEA, SIPOC, DLPM, HLPM, etc.) and supported initiatives.

 Delivered AI-enabled contract and document management using Evisort,
enabling clause extraction and metadata tagging to reduce cycle time, manual

Built advanced Power BI and Qlik Sense dashboards using SQL, R Studio, and
Python, big data analytics including one named “Funnel Analyzer” for workforce
forecasting, hiring timelines, sourcing effectiveness, and recruiter performance.
Identified and led multiple RPA initiatives across functions and processes to
automate both workflows and manual processing.
Built and led multiple one-stop analytical dashboards leveraging SQL, R
Studio, Big Data, and machine-learning models to deliver actionable business
insights and decision support.
Conducted deep process studies and mining across functions/teams using
Celonis, AIDT, entitlement, and time-and-motion analyses to identify rework,
bottlenecks, overutilization, and non-value-added activities, eliminating them
through workflow automation and RPA.
Deployment of operational excellence tools across functions and teams.
Operational Maturity, Quality & Governance
Led enterprise operational maturity assessments using Value Stream Mapping,
Entitlement Studies, BOI Tree, Process Maturity Measurement, Benchmark
Analytics Tool, SLAs/SLA+, and Standard Quality Framework, driving quality,
efficiency, and contractual compliance outcomes.
Improved client experience and CSAT by enabling digital NPS and sentiment
analytics dashboards, guiding insight interpretation, action planning, and
validating improvements through recurring maturity checkpoints.
Strengthened enterprise risk and compliance maturity using Accenture Control
Framework, FMEA, SOPs/LWIs, SIPOCs, early-warning indicators, and assurance
reviews, ensuring audit-ready, controlled operations.
Translated contractual commitments into measurable delivery outcomes through
BOI Tree mapping, maturity-linked KPIs, and governance reviews validating
evidence and performance.
Automation, GenAI & Intelligent Operations
Assessed baseline productivity and designed automation and GenAI roadmaps
leveraging RPA, LCNC, mini-bots, Generative AI–Human Assist, and Accenture
platforms, validating benefits realization and productivity uplift.
Enabled advanced automation and intelligent operations maturity through
process modernization and AI-driven interventions, achieving top-quartile
productivity benchmarks.
Guided AI- and automation-led transformation roadmaps, validating readiness
for autonomous and agentic operations using autonomy-focused maturity
assessments.
Value Realization, Analytics & Diagnostics
Delivered maturity-led diagnostics using process mining, variance analysis, Value
Stream Mapping, and analytics modelling to identify NVA, enable reengineering,
and deliver measurable business outcomes across internal delivery teams.
Established enterprise BOI, SLA, and KPI governance frameworks enabling
automation pipelines, benefits-realization validation, and outcome-based value
tracking.
Built enterprise KPI architectures and 3×3 leading–lagging frameworks using
Regression analytics.
Built and also enabled one stop shop digital dashboards to improve business
intelligence using Power BI, Qlik Sense ,big-data analytics and machine learning
to enable forecasting, performance monitoring, and improvement advisory.
CXO Advisory, Governance & Assurance
Advised senior leadership on end-to-end enterprise transformation roadmaps,
validating CXO-level business outcomes through maturity-driven governance.
Owned monthly operational maturity assessments across multiple OMIDs,
ensuring Operational Excellence adherence, stage progression, leadership
reporting, digital governance, and performance appraisal alignment.
Acted as cross-functional Business Transformation Auditor, validating maturity
scores, evidence quality, control effectiveness, and outcome realization across
internal portfolios.
Established enterprise
including maturity

mechanisms, and finance-approved business cases.
transformation governance
Documented and signed off stage-wise project status, savings accounting, and FTE
reconciliation through Digi-Portal governance.
Capability Building & Change Enablement
Supported cross-geography internal delivery teams through maturity-based
process reviews, redesigns, and analytics-led interventions.
Built organization-wide capability by delivering Yellow Belt and Green Belt
programs and change enablement workshops, embedding a continuous
improvement, automation-first and transformation-ready culture.
Operational Excellence Platforms & Tool Deployments
Led Accenture Control Framework deployment by designing process-specific
controls, executing phased rollouts, embedding failure-mode analysis, and
delivering measurable compliance, risk mitigation, and governance benefits.
Drove process maturity uplift by deploying Process Maturity Measurement and
Benchmarking Analytics Tool, benchmarking against global standards and
delivering targeted efficiency improvements.
Partnered with compliance teams to deploy Standard Quality Framework,
strengthening end-to-end audit readiness and alignment with evolving quality
requirements.
Deployed Global Productivity Hub to 2,000+ users, managing UAT-to-go-live and
delivering analytics on efficiency, productivity utilization, and capacity utilization
to identify automation opportunities.

Managed telecom lifecycle projects, navigating phases involving legal, finance,

Prepared business cases, financial justifications & documentation to secure

Closed projects in line with SLA timelines while monitoring risks, dependencies,

Creating advanced excel and analytical models for Vendor penalty and multiple

Participated in OE and quality initiatives creating process artefacts such as

Led quality initiatives and contributed to innovative internal platforms such as
